clue.text: Tug left to right inside to form loop

indicators.note: the inner L (left) of the synonym is swapped for R (right)

parts.note: to tug something is to pull it

explanation.surface: An instruction for knotting a rope: pull across from left to right to make a loop.
explanation.walkthrough: 'left to right inside' changes the second L of PULL into R. A purl is a knitting stitch, made by looping the yarn.
explanation.definitionFit: In knitting, a purl stitch is made by drawing yarn through as a loop, so the verb means make that loop.

clue.text: Officer on instrument having lost concentration

indicators.note: in a down clue, one piece placed on top of the next

parts.note: DI is a Detective Inspector, a police officer
a lute is a stringed instrument

explanation.surface: A police officer playing an instrument has lost his focus.
explanation.definitionFit: A dilute solution is one weakened, its concentration reduced by added water.

clue.text: Deer eat frozen shoots in unprotected frontier area?

explanation.surface: Deer nibble at frozen plant shoots in an exposed border region.
explanation.walkthrough: 'shoots' looks like the deer's food, but it signals the anagram.
explanation.definitionFit: Such a zone has no tariff barriers, so its trade is not protected at the border; the question mark flags the playful wording.

clue.text: Mountaineer's novel turn of phrase

indicators.note: a new twist given to the word that follows, so its letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A climber's original choice of expression.
explanation.definitionFit: Sherpas are Himalayan people famed as climbers and guides on expeditions.

clue.text: Agreements to rewrite end of composition

parts.note: a treatise is a written composition on a subject

explanation.walkthrough: 'rewrite end of' swaps the final E and S of TREATISE.
explanation.definitionFit: Treaties are formal agreements between states.

clue.text: Convincing evidence of air pollution head of state introduced before international forum

one piece is brought into the middle of another

parts.note: smog is polluted air
a king is a head of state
the UN, United Nations, is a forum for nations

explanation.surface: Proof of air pollution produced when a leader was brought before a world body.
explanation.definitionFit: A smoking gun is an idiom for incontrovertible proof of guilt.

clue.text: Queen is not Queen? Curiouser and curiouser!

parts.note: ER, Elizabeth Regina, is the Queen
ain't is a colloquial form of is not
ER, Elizabeth Regina, is the Queen

explanation.surface: Alice's famous exclamation about something odd, the Queen not being the Queen.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition quotes Alice in Wonderland; it means simply more curious, more odd.
explanation.definitionFit: Quaint means oddly old-fashioned, so its comparative is a synonym for more curious.

clue.text: Greek hero taking positions around entrance to underworld

indicators.note: the opening letter of the following word

explanation.walkthrough: The surface fits: Theseus did visit the underworld.
explanation.definitionFit: Theseus, slayer of the Minotaur, is a hero of Greek myth.

clue.text: Wives' associations run by woman who may or may not be one

parts.note: to hare is to run fast

explanation.walkthrough: 'one' refers back to a wife: Ms does not reveal marital status.

clue.text: Refer an obscene broadcast

explanation.definitionFit: To earmark something is to set it aside for a particular purpose.

clue.text: Windows users going through 'force quit' operation experience this

definitions.text: Windows users going through 'force quit' operation experience this

parts.words: Windows users going through 'force quit' operation experience this

explanation.walkthrough: The computer jargon misleads: 'force quit' is a person forcibly expelled 'going through' a window.
explanation.definitionFit: The term means the act of throwing someone out of a window, from Latin fenestra.

clue.text: The thing is, beer's going up — financial centre's indication of how that may affect demand
